about: Comparisons over resource attributes and literals, one probe per behaviour no earlier golden reached: an operator over a pair of value types (string, number, boolean, null, list, object, empty values) with the result it gives, and how two scalars relate (same text, same ignoring case, the same number spelled differently). Each condition is <comparison> OR resource.a == 'y'; every probe is asked with a = 'n' and a = 'y', which tells true, a false comparison and an ended rule apart.
